name: Supercharge
tagline: Fix your everyday macOS frustrations with optional improvements to Finder, windows, and system controls.
description:
Supercharge is a collection of small, optional improvements for macOS. Rather than replacing Finder, the Dock, or Mission Control, it adds switches for behaviors that are missing or awkward in the system itself. Every enhancement can be enabled independently.

## Features

- Add Finder actions such as creating files, copying paths, handling images, and improving common clipboard operations.
- Adjust Dock, Mission Control, window, notification, screenshot, and menu-bar behavior.
- Add OCR, QR-code, media-key, trackpad, keyboard, and keep-awake utilities.
- Remove image location metadata and automatically clear the clipboard for privacy-sensitive workflows.
- Assign keyboard shortcuts to frequently used enhancements.
- Export and import settings when moving to another Mac.

## Where it fits

Supercharge is for experienced Mac users who can name several small system frustrations but do not want a separate app for every fix. Its breadth is the appeal, but it also means permissions and settings deserve careful review. Enable only the behaviors you understand and need.

## Privacy and requirements

The current version requires macOS 26 or later. Some features require Accessibility, Automation, Screen Recording, or other macOS permissions because they modify system interactions. The developer offers an older unsupported build for macOS 15.

## Pricing

Supercharge costs $20 as a one-time purchase with free updates. A fully functional trial is available and shows a purchase reminder every 12 hours.
